Label: Contingencies of Self-Worth Scale
Description: Contingencies of Self-Worth Scale. Measures contingencies of self-worth. 35 items. Reference: Crocker, J., Luhtanen, R. K., Cooper, M. L., & Bouvrette, A. (2003). Contingencies of self-worth in college students: Theory and measurement. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 85(5), 894-908.
